label: Shemaiah

text.KJV NEH 12:17: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai:
text.KJV NEH 12:18: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
text.KJV NEH 12:19: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

A.name: Shemaiah
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:8)

B.name: Shemaiah
B.line: Priest who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, head of a priestly house

why: לִשְׁמַעְיָה יְהוֹנָתָן (“of Shemaiah, Jehonathan”) follows the surrounding pattern of priestly houses and their representatives, best matching B’s stated role as a priestly house head. Both records claim Jehonathan as a descendant, so that relationship alone cannot distinguish them, and the local verses leave some uncertainty.
